highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates upstream Skia m158 bug fixes.
highlights_body: The shared hash-code implementation also switches to operating-system cryptographic randomness for its per-process seed.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine with upstream fixes from chrome/m158.

The shared HashCode implementation in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now obtains its seed from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Switched the shared hash-code seed to operating-system cryptographic randomness and added analyzer checks for shipped code.
